title: Business Development Associate
description:
**BUSINESS DEVELOPMENT EXECUTIVE**

**ABOUT US**

Vutto is a full-stack, phygital platform transforming the used two-wheeler market in India. We combine certified online listings with offline retail experience, in-house refurbishment, warranty support, and end-to-end documentation to deliver a seamless and trustworthy experience.

**ABOUT THE ROLE**

At Vutto, we're building India's most trusted brand in pre-owned bikes. We’re growing fast and expanding our direct-from-customer procurement model — and we need sharp, detail-oriented sales professional to onboard used bike dealers across the assigned region. If you’ve worked with bikes, know your way around an engine, and want to be part of a fast-paced, high-performance team — this role is for you.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES.**

* Onboard and manage used bike dealers across the assigned region to expand the company’s dealer network.
* Drive dealer activation through regular market visits, relationship building, and structured follow-ups to achieve monthly onboarding and revenue targets.
* Own assigned territory by identifying, visiting, and converting prospective dealers into active partners.
* Manage the complete dealer onboarding lifecycle, including lead generation, pitching, documentation, training, and go-live support.
* Build and maintain strong long-term relationships with dealers to ensure engagement, retention, and consistent business flow.
* Track dealer performance, leads, and conversions using Google Sheets and CRM tools to ensure accurate reporting and performance analysis.
* Provide market intelligence, competitor insights, and feedback to internal teams to optimize onboarding and sales strategies.

**KEY REQUIREMENT**

* 2-3 years of experience in field sales/ from FMCG industry preferably
* Good communication/convincing skills
* Graduation in any stream/ BBA preferred
* Good understanding of bikes/ and parts (preferred)
* Good familiarity of Jaipur Network

**WHY JOIN US?**

* Competitive pay
* Exciting opportunity to be part of high paced start-up.
* Great work culture.
* Health benefits
* Flexible work timings

Pay: ₹25,000.00 - ₹29,000.00 per month

Benefits:

* Provident Fund

Work Location: In person
